title: Quarterly OKR Cascade + Risk Budgeting: Initiative Windowing & Cross-team Escalation Flow
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: As company objectives scale across Dedicated, Private, and Console initiatives, teams frequently over-commit to OKR-linked work and surface late-stage risks that push scope into subsequent quarters. This causes cascading re-prioritization, missed SLAs for Dedicated customers, and unpredictable capacity for infra/serving runtime teams.

Goal: Define a repeatable quarterly cascading cadence that (1) maps company-level OKRs to a bounded set of initiatives with clear timeboxes (initiative windows), (2) reserves a risk budget (capacity + squad buffer) per company objective, and (3) establishes a cross-team escalation flow (escape hatches) to arbitrate scope vs. risk during the quarter.

Proposed approach: 1) Create a 6-week initiative window template aligned to the quarterly planning calendar; 2) For each company OKR, allocate a risk budget (expressed in story points and GPU-hours) that live-owners may consume when unplanned regressions or regulatory work arises; 3) Build an escalation flow (PM -> Eng Lead -> Product Ops -> Exec) with defined SLAs for decisions (24h triage, 72h resolution) and a lightweight decision record; 4) Integrate this flow into the Roadmap Dashboard and the OKR telemetry (KPIs: committed vs delivered, risk budget consumption, # of escalations and resolution time).

Trade-offs considered:
- Rigid windows reduce agility for small experiments but improve predictability for infra and Dedicated capacity teams.
- Quantifying risk budget (points + GPU-hours) is a blunt instrument; we will iterate using historical incident/capacity data.
- Formal escalation adds process overhead; mitigated by a lightweight template and automation in the Roadmap Dashboard.

Rollout plan: Draft runbook -> pilot with Runtime and Console teams for Q2 planning -> collect telemetry -> revise and scale across org for Q3.

Success metrics (initial): 25% reduction in cross-quarter scope creep for OKR-linked initiatives, mean escalation resolution time <72h, and <10% variance between planned and observed Dedicated capacity consumption per objective.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Initiative window template published in Confluence with fields: objective mapping, risk budget (points + GPU-hours), owners, decision record link.
A2: Roadmap Dashboard updated to display risk budget consumption per objective and a visualization of initiative windows.
A3: Escalation flow documented with SLAs and automated notification hooks (Slack) to the resolution channel.
A4: Pilot run completed with Runtime and Console teams for Q2; pilot retrospective held and action items logged.

T2: Define risk budget schema (points, GPU-hours) and implement mapping in Roadmap Dashboard (owner: Marco).

T4: Pilot kickoff with Runtime + Console leads, capture telemetry baseline (owner: Marco & Lena).
